info.name: List the restore tasks in a project.

params.name: project_id
params.description: The ID of your project. You can get the project ID from the response of [List all accessible projects.](#tag/Project/operation/ListProjects).

items.docs: For TiDB Cloud Starter instances, you cannot create or manage restore tasks via API.

params.name: project_id
params.description: The ID of the project. You can get the project ID from the response of [List all accessible projects.](#tag/Project/operation/ListProjects).

items.docs:
You can use this endpoint to restore data from a previously created backup file to a new cluster. In this endpoint, you must specify the configuration of the new cluster you want to restore data to.

**Limitations:**

- For TiDB Cloud Dedicated clusters, you can only restore data from a smaller node size to a larger node size.

- You cannot restore data from a TiDB Cloud Dedicated cluster to a TiDB Cloud Starter instance.

For TiDB Cloud Starter instances, you cannot create restore tasks via API

params.name: project_id
params.description: The ID of your project. You can get the project ID from the response of [List all accessible projects.](#tag/Project/operation/ListProjects).

params.name: restore_id
params.description: The ID of the restore task.

items.docs: For TiDB Cloud Starter instances, you cannot manage restore tasks via API.
